summary: Petition under Section 79 (1)(a) and (f) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for payment towards the energy bills raised by the Petitioner on the basis of the scheduled energy to be certified at point D by Gujarat SLDC which is the delivery point in terms of the RfS and PPA provisions. **Parties Present:** Ms. Anushree Bardhan, Advocate, SJVNGEL Ms. Ritika Singh, Advocate, SJVNGEL Shri Anand K Ganesan, Advocate, GUVNL & GSLDC Shri Utkarsh Singh, Advocate, GUVNL & GSLDC Ms. Sneha Singh, Advocate, GUVNL & GSLDC SJVN Green Energy Limited (hereinafter referred to as ‘Petitioner’/ ‘SGEL’) has filed the present Petition seeking adjudication of a dispute regarding the delivery point for the scheduled energy in terms of the RfS, PPA, Implementation and Support Agreement and the Tripartite Connection Agreement. The Petitioner has also sought direction to the Gujarat SLDC to amend the monthly State Energy Account from April 2024 onwards, and to GUVNL to make payments on the basis of the revised monthly State Energy Account from April 2024 onwards, along with interest/carrying costs. The Petitioner has made the following prayers: - _(b) Hold and Declare that GUVNL ought to make payment towards the energy bills raised by the Petitioner on the basis of the scheduled energy to be certified at point D by Gujarat SLDC;_ - _(d) Pass such other Order(s) and this Hon’ble Commission may deem just and proper in the circumstances of the case._ - (c) On 19.06.2023, the Petitioner entered into an Implementation and Support Agreement (ISA) with the Gujarat Power Corporation Limited (GPCL) (i.e. the Solar Power Park Developer for the facilitation and implementation of the 700 MW Raghanesda Solar Park). - (v) A dispute has arisen between the Petitioner and GUVNL as GUVNL is not making payments to the Petitioner in terms of the power scheduled at point D, which is the delivery point in terms of the RfS and PPA provisions. This is because in the State Energy Account certified by Gujarat SLDC- GETCO for the Petitioner’s 100 MW plant, the energy scheduled are recorded and certified at points H1, H2 and H3 as against Point D, which is the delivery point in terms of the RfS, PPA, ISA and the Tripartite Connection Agreement **2.** The learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the petition has been filed seeking payment of the energy bills of the scheduled energy, to be certified at point D, which shall be the delivery point. The learned counsel for the Respondent requested that SLDC be impleaded as a party respondent in the present case. This was not objected to by the other party. After hearing the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission admitted the Petition and directed the issuance of notice to the Respondents. The Commission also directed the Petitioner to implead SLDC as a Respondent in the petition, and to file a revised memo of parties and Respondents to file their replies. **3.** In compliance with the RoP for hearing dated 24.06.2025, the Petitioner vide affidavit dated 07.07.2025 has impleaded SLDC, Gujarat as a party to the present Petition and filed the revised memo of parties. - (a) The Petitioner is seeking to redefine the very provision of “Delivery Point” and also other provisions of the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) dated 03.01.2022, entered **5.** The Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 11.09.2025, in its Rejoinder to GUVNL’s Reply, has submitted as under: - (c) The claims of the Petitioner, being premised upon the erroneous schematic diagram, are misconceived and untenable. The correct schematic, read with the PPA and Supplementary PPA, as well as the State Energy Accounts issued by Gujarat SLDC, conclusively establishes that the Delivery Point is at the GETCO periphery and not at the CTU bus, as wrongly suggested by the Petitioner. **7.** The Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 08.10.2025, in its Rejoinder to Gujarat SLDC’s Reply, has submitted as under: **8.** After hearing the learned counsel for the Petitioner and the Respondents, at length, the Commission reserved the matter for order. The Commission also directed the parties to file their written notes of arguments. **9.** The Petitioner, on 03.11.2025, has filed their written note of arguments in which they have reiterated their earlier submissions. Apart from the submissions already covered, the Petitioner has submitted that, on account of the Respondents' incorrect interpretation of the delivery point, the Petitioner has suffered financial losses to the **16.** We have considered the submissions of Petitioner and Respondents. The issues which arise for our consideration are as follows: _2.) Ms. Gujarat Power Corporation Limited (GPCL being "Solar Power Park Developer" (SPPD) applying for connectivity on behalf of "Solar Power Developers" (SPDs) a Company Registered under the Companies Act 1956 & the Companies Act 2013, having its Registered Office Block No.8, 6th Floor, Udyog Bhavan, Sector-11, Gandhinagar, Gujarat - 382011._ _**(herein after called "the Applicant")** which expression shall unless repugnant to the context or meaning thereof be deemed to mean and include its successors or permitted assigns and each of the parties hereto being a "Party" and the term "Parties" shall be construed accordingly as the second Party._ _(Herein after referred to as confirming party, which expression shall include its permitted assigns and successors) a party the Third Part_
